claims.text: Cantharidin 0.7% (thin skin) or 1% (thicker skin), alone or with salicylic acid 30% and podophyllum 5%; washed off at 6 hours alone or 2 hours in combination
claims.quote: Cantharidin (0.7% on thin-skinned areas and 1% on thicker-skinned areas) can be used alone or in combination with SCA 30% and podophyllum 5% in a collodion base. Cantharidin alone is removed with soap and water after 6 hours; cantharidin with SCA or podophyllum is removed in 2 hours.

claims.text: Plantar warts: after debridement, caustics such as 30 to 70% trichloroacetic acid
claims.quote: The wart is then mechanically debrided while damp and soft, followed by destruction by freezing or using caustics (eg, 30 to 70% trichloroacetic acid).
